ValidationRule.description: Requires positive estimated effort when a Case is transferred from a queue to a user, except for users with the HES data-load bypass permission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.HES_Data_Load_Bypass), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), LEFT(PRIORVALUE(OwnerId), 3) = "00G", LEFT(OwnerId, 3) = "005", OR( ISBLANK(Estimated_Effort_Hours__c), Estimated_Effort_Hours__c <= 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter estimated effort greater than 0 before assigning this Case to a user.
